#### List:

- PC
- PK
- PD
- Special

#### Physicochemical:

+------------------------------+--------------------------------------+----------------------------+
|                              | **Suxamethonium**                    | **Rocuronium**             |
+==============================+======================================+============================+
| Container                    | Plastic ampoule                      | Glass vial or ampoule      |
+------------------------------+--------------------------------------+----------------------------+
| Contents: drug and additives | Aqueous solution pH 3.5              | Aqueous solution pH 4      |
|                              |                                      |                            |
|                              | (Precipitate with thiopentone pH 11) | Precipitation rare         |
|                              |                                      |                            |
|                              | Suxamethonium chloride 50mg/mL       | Rocuronium bromide 10mg/mL |
+------------------------------+--------------------------------------+----------------------------+
| Needs refrigeration          | Y                                    | Y                          |
+------------------------------+--------------------------------------+----------------------------+
| Life at room temp            | 2/52                                 | 2/12                       |
|                              |                                      |                            |
| (accept 10% loss of potency) |                                      |                            |
+------------------------------+--------------------------------------+----------------------------+
| Needs reconstitution         | No                                   | No                         |
+------------------------------+--------------------------------------+----------------------------+

#### Pharmacokinetic:

+---------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                 | **Suxamethonium**                                                   | **Rocuronium**                                                  |
+=================================+=====================================================================+=================================================================+
| **Admin:**                      |                                                                     |                                                                 |
+---------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
| - ED~95~ mg/kg                  | 0.3                                                                 | 0.3                                                             |
+---------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
| - Intubating dose mg/kg         | 1-1.5 (4x)                                                          | 0.6-1.2 (2-4x)                                                  |
+---------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
| - IM                            | Y                                                                   | N                                                               |
|                                 |                                                                     |                                                                 |
|                                 | 2-3mg/kg                                                            |                                                                 |
|                                 |                                                                     |                                                                 |
|                                 | (Useful if larygospasm during paediatric gas induction without IVC) |                                                                 |
+---------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
| - Intralingual                  | Y (as for IM)                                                       | N                                                               |
+---------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
| - Phase 2 blockade mg/kg        | 3-5                                                                 | N/A                                                             |
+---------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Time course**                 |                                                                     |                                                                 |
+---------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
| - Onset IV 2xED~95~ dose (mins) | 0.5-1                                                               | 1-1.5 (\<1 if 4x ED~95~)                                        |
|                                 |                                                                     |                                                                 |
|                                 | (limited by cardiac output)                                         |                                                                 |
+---------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
| - Duration IV (mins)            | 5 (normal)                                                          | 30-40                                                           |
|                                 |                                                                     |                                                                 |
|                                 | (ideal for very short case e.g. ECT)                                | (Longer if 4x ED~95~)                                           |
+---------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Absorption:**                 | **N/A**                                                             | **N/A**                                                         |
+---------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Distribution:**               |                                                                     |                                                                 |
+---------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
| - V~DSS~                        | 0.2L/kg                                                             | 0.2L/kg                                                         |
+---------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
| - %PPB                          | Unknown                                                             | 10%                                                             |
+---------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
| - Crosses placenta              | Minimal                                                             | Minimal                                                         |
+---------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Metabolism:**                 |                                                                     |                                                                 |
+---------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
| - Mode                          | PChE near 100%                                                      | Hepatic \<5%                                                    |
|                                 |                                                                     |                                                                 |
|                                 | Two stage                                                           |                                                                 |
|                                 |                                                                     |                                                                 |
|                                 | Products: succinic acid, choline                                    |                                                                 |
+---------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
| - Active metabolites            | Nil                                                                 | 17-desacetyl-rocuronium (much less active, hepatic elimination) |
+---------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
| - t~1/2~~β~ (mins)              | 1-2                                                                 | 70                                                              |
+---------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Excretion**                   | (minimal)                                                           | (95%)                                                           |
+---------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
| \% in bile                      | \-                                                                  | 60%                                                             |
|                                 |                                                                     |                                                                 |
|                                 |                                                                     | (liver failure → prolonged)                                     |
+---------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
| \% in urine                     | 10% parent                                                          | 40%                                                             |
|                                 |                                                                     |                                                                 |
|                                 | 100% metabolites                                                    | (renal failure → prolonged)                                     |
+---------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+

#### Pharmacodynamic:

+--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+
|                                      | **Suxamethonium**                                                                                      | **Rocuronium**                            |
+======================================+========================================================================================================+===========================================+
| **Therapeutic effect:**              |                                                                                                        |                                           |
+--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+
| - Action at junctional nAChR         | Depolarising blockade                                                                                  | Non-depolarising blockade                 |
|                                      |                                                                                                        |                                           |
|                                      | Non-classical receptor effect                                                                          | Competitive antagonist                    |
|                                      |                                                                                                        |                                           |
|                                      | ?Non-competitive partial agonist                                                                       |                                           |
+--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+
| **Use:**                             |                                                                                                        |                                           |
+--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+
| Rapid sequence induction             | Y                                                                                                      | Y (↑dose → ↑speed of onset but ↑duration) |
+--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+
| Surgical access e.g. laparotomy      | Y (but usually too brief)                                                                              | Y                                         |
+--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+
| Infusion                             | N (develop phase 2 block)                                                                              | Y (but offset variable)                   |
+--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+
| **Monitoring:**                      |                                                                                                        |                                           |
+--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+
| - Single twitch                      | ↓                                                                                                      | ↓                                         |
+--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+
| - TOF ratio                          | Phase 1 \>0.7                                                                                          | \<0.3                                     |
|                                      |                                                                                                        |                                           |
|                                      | Phase 2 \<0.7                                                                                          |                                           |
+--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+
| - Response to tetany                 | Phase 1 sustained                                                                                      | Fade                                      |
|                                      |                                                                                                        |                                           |
|                                      | Phase 2 fade                                                                                           |                                           |
+--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+
| - Post-tetanic potentiation          | Phase 1 yes                                                                                            | Yes                                       |
|                                      |                                                                                                        |                                           |
|                                      | Phase 2 no                                                                                             |                                           |
+--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+
| **Side effects:**                    |                                                                                                        |                                           |
+--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+
| - Myalgia                            | Y                                                                                                      | N                                         |
+--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+
| - Arrhythmia                         | Sinus bradycardia                                                                                      | Rare                                      |
|                                      |                                                                                                        |                                           |
|                                      | AV block                                                                                               |                                           |
+--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+
| - ↑K^+^                              | Y                                                                                                      | N                                         |
|                                      |                                                                                                        |                                           |
|                                      | (contraindicated if ↑↑extra-junctional receptors e.g. burns, prolonged immobility, spinal cord injury) |                                           |
+--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+
| - Histamine release                  | Y                                                                                                      | N                                         |
+--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+
| - Anaphylaxis (arguments!!)          | 1 in 2000                                                                                              | 1 in 2500                                 |
+--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+
| - ↑Intragastric pressure             | +10cmH~2~O (but also ↑lower oesophageal sphincter tone)                                                |                                           |
+--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+
| - ↑Intra-ocular pressure             | +10cmH~2~O? (avoid if open globe injury)                                                               |                                           |
+--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+
| - Polymorphism → prolonged paralysis | Rare                                                                                                   | N                                         |
|                                      |                                                                                                        |                                           |
|                                      | (avoid and test if FHx sux apnoea)                                                                     |                                           |
+--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+
| - Malignant hyperthermia             | Y                                                                                                      | N                                         |
+--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+
|                                      |                                                                                                        |                                           |
+--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+
| **Reversal:**                        |                                                                                                        |                                           |
+--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+
| - Spontaneous                        | Y and fast (5min after 4xED~95~)                                                                       | Y but slow (30-40mins after 2xED~95~)     |
+--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+
| - AChEi reversal                     | Phase 1 augmented                                                                                      | Antagonised                               |
|                                      |                                                                                                        |                                           |
|                                      | Phase 2 antagonised                                                                                    |                                           |
+--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+
| - Chelation reversal                 | No                                                                                                     | g-cyclodextrin                            |
+--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+
|                                      |                                                                                                        |                                           |
+--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+
